Speak to [[Headmaster Greico]] to begin your [[ranger]] training.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Ranger
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
* Seek out Headmaster Greico in the monastery.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]
==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s
* {{skill icon|Power Shot}}
* {{skill icon|Troll Unguent}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Bow]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Greico, who is nearby, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Ludo'''
:''"Greetings and welcome, young Ranger. You must be looking for '''Headmaster Greico'''. He is in charge of training all new Ranger students. Look for him in the '''monastery'''. Have a pleasant day!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Greico.
| decline = I'd like to sped some time exploring, first.
| ask = '''Headmaster Greico''' is waiting for you in the monastery.
| indent = ::
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Headmaster Greico'''
:''"Ludo is a good man. He would have made a fine Luxon, were he not so fond of staying in one place."''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
